articles.Title: ‘That’s Ranbir for me’: Alia Bhatt on feeling seen and heard in her marriage
articles.Description: Actor Alia Bhatt recently responded to speculation that her marriage to Ranbir Kapoor is unequal and that she lacks agency in the relationship, calling such assumptions offensive and saying she feels seen and understood by her husband. Taking a cue from her remarks, psychotherapist and relationship breakthrough coach Delnna Rrajesh explained that a healthy marriage allows both partners to express their preferences, disagree and influence each other without control or fear of losing emotional security. She noted that people often interpret other couples' relationships through the lens of their own experiences, but isolated remarks or public appearances cannot reveal how partners navigate conflict and responsibility in private. Delnna also cautioned against replacing traditional expectations of how women should behave in marriage with rigid ideas of what an empowered woman must look like, emphasising that choosing to compromise or value a partner's opinion does not automatically mean a woman lacks agency. She added that the real test of a healthy marriage lies in how couples handle disagreements, respect boundaries and make room for both individuals to grow without fear or coercion.
